candidate.de: Pupnat celebrates its main feast day with a religious service, followed by entertainment and cultural programs.
candidate.en: Gospa od Sniga — Our Lady of the Snows (5 August) — the village’s main feast day, celebrated at the parish church with a religious service followed by entertainment and cultural programmes.
candidate.fr: La Gospa od Sniga — Notre Dame des Neiges (5 août) — la fête principale du village, célébrée à l'église paroissiale avec un service religieux suivi de divertissements et de programmes culturels.
candidate.hr: Gospa od Sniga — Naša Gospa Snježnog (5. kolovoza) — glavna blagdan u Pupnatu, slavljena u crkvi sa bogoslužjem, nakon čega slijede zabave i kulturna programa.
candidate.it: Gospa od Sniga — Nostra Signora della Neve (5 agosto) — la principale festa del villaggio, celebrata nella chiesa parrocchiale con un servizio religioso seguito da intrattenimenti e programmi culturali.
candidate.sl: Gospa od Sniga — Naša gospa snježnega (5. avgusta) — glavni praznik v Pupnati, slavljen v cerkvi s bogoslužjem, nakon katerega sledijo zabave in kulturna programa.

candidate.de: Paddle through the sheltered waters of the Korcula archipelago and discover a 14th-century Franciscan monastery, free-roaming deer, and the ancient limestone quarry that built the walls of Dubrovnik — all in three hours, no experience required.

desc.hr: Plavalite kroz zaštićena voda Korčulskog otočja i otkrijte 14. stoljećni franjevački samostan, slobodno kretanje jelena i staru kamenu kamenolu koji je izgradio zidine Dubrovnika — sve u tri sata, bez iskustva potrebno.
desc.sl: Plavalite skozi zaščiten vodo Korčulškega otočja in odkrijte 14. stoletni frančiščanski samostan, sprosto kresanje jelenov in stare kamene kamenolom, ki je zgradil zidove Dubrovnika — vse v tri ure, brez potrebe po izkušnji.

candidate.fr: Plongez dans les eaux abritées de l'archipel de Korcula et découvrez un monastère franciscain du XIVe siècle, des cerfs libres et un ancien carrières de pierre qui ont construit les murs de Dubrovnik — tout en trois heures, sans expérience requise.
candidate.hr: Paddle through the sheltered waters of the Korcula archipelago and discover a 14th-century Franciscan monastery, free-roaming deer, and the ancient limestone quarry that built the walls of Dubrovnik — all in three hours, no experience required.
candidate.it: Paddaia attraverso le acque protette dell'arcipelago di Korcula e scopri un monastero francescano del XIV secolo, cervi liberi e un antico cantiere di pietra che ha costruito le mura di Dubrovnik — tutto in tre ore, senza esperienza necessaria.
candidate.sl: Plavalite skozi zaščiten vodo Korčulškega otočja in odkrijte 14. stoletni frančiščanski samostan, sprosto kresanje jelenov in stare kamene kamenolom, ki je zgradil zidove Dubrovnika — vse v tri ure, brez potrebe po izkušnji.
